name: Google Drive
description: Google Drive is a cloud storage solution for uploading, sharing, and collaborating on files across devices, with robust search and offline access

tools.name: Add file sharing preference (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use GOOGLEDRIVE_CREATE_PERMISSION instead; use GOOGLEDRIVE_UPDATE_PERMISSION to modify existing permissions (avoids duplicate entries). Modifies sharing permissions for an existing Google Drive file, granting a specified role to a user, group, domain, or 'anyone'. Bulk calls may trigger 403 rateLimitExceeded (~100 req/100s/user); use jittered exponential backoff.

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: Permission role to grant. Accepted values: 'reader', 'commenter', 'writer', 'fileOrganizer', 'organizer', 'owner'. Invalid strings cause validation failures.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Type of grantee for the permission. Using 'anyone' with 'writer' or 'owner' broadly exposes the document — confirm before applying. Admin policies may block 'anyone' or domain-wide sharing. For type='anyone' with role='reader', the link must be explicitly shared; files are not publicly searchable.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.about: Domain to grant permission to (e.g., 'example.com'). Required if 'type' is 'domain'.

inputs.name: file_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the file to update sharing settings for. Must be an alphanumeric string containing only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores (no slashes, spaces, or other special characters). Use GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE or GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_FILES to get valid file IDs from your Google Drive.

inputs.name: email_address
inputs.about: Email address of the user or group. Required if 'type' is 'user' or 'group'.

inputs.name: transfer_ownership
inputs.about: Whether to transfer ownership to the specified user. Required when role is 'owner'. Only a single user can be specified in the request when transferring ownership. Ownership transfer is difficult to reverse — obtain explicit confirmation before setting true.

inputs.name: enforceSingleParent
inputs.about: Deprecated: Adding files to multiple folders is no longer supported. Use shortcuts instead.

tools.name: Create Permission
tools.description: Tool to create a permission for a file or shared drive. Use when you need to share a file or folder with users, groups, domains, or make it publicly accessible. **Warning:** Concurrent permissions operations on the same file are not supported; only the last update is applied.

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: The role granted by this permission. Valid values are: owner, organizer, fileOrganizer, writer, commenter, reader.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The type of the grantee. When creating a permission, if type is 'user' or 'group', you must provide an emailAddress. When type is 'domain', you must provide a domain. There isn't extra information required for 'anyone' type.

inputs.name: email_message
inputs.about: A plain text custom message to include in the notification email.

inputs.name: expiration_time
inputs.about: The time at which this permission will expire (RFC 3339 date-time). Expiration times can only be set on user and group permissions, must be in the future, and cannot be more than a year in the future.

inputs.name: transfer_ownership
inputs.about: Whether to transfer ownership to the specified user and downgrade the current owner to a writer. This parameter is required as an acknowledgement of the side effect.

inputs.name: supports_all_drives
inputs.about: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives.

inputs.name: allow_file_discovery
inputs.about: Whether the permission allows the file to be discovered through search. This is only applicable for permissions of type 'domain' or 'anyone'.

inputs.name: move_to_new_owners_root
inputs.about: This parameter will only take effect if the item is not in a shared drive and the request is attempting to transfer the ownership of the item. If set to true, the item will be moved to the new owner's My Drive root folder and all prior parents removed. If set to false, parents are not changed.

inputs.name: send_notification_email
inputs.about: Whether to send a notification email when sharing to users or groups. This defaults to true for users and groups, and is not allowed for other requests. It must not be disabled for ownership transfers.

inputs.name: use_domain_admin_access
inputs.about: Issue the request as a domain administrator; if set to true, then the requester will be granted access if the file ID parameter refers to a shared drive and the requester is an administrator of the domain to which the shared drive belongs.

tools.description: Subscribe to Google Drive changes for a user or shared drive and receive notifications at a webhook URL. Supply a start or continuation page token; notifications may cover multiple changes, so fetch changes since the last known token.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: A unique string that identifies this channel. UUIDs are recommended. Must be unique per active channel; reusing an ID can cause missed, delayed, or duplicate notifications.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The type of delivery mechanism for notifications.

inputs.name: token
inputs.about: An arbitrary string that will be delivered with each notification. Can be used for verification.

inputs.name: params
inputs.about:
Optional parameters for the notification channel.
Example: {"additional_properties": {"ttl": "3600"}} for a 1-hour time-to-live (actual support depends on Google API).

inputs.name: spaces
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of spaces to query within the corpora. Supported values are 'drive' and 'appDataFolder'.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: The URL where notifications are to be delivered. Must be a publicly reachable HTTPS URL with a valid SSL certificate; HTTP, localhost, and private network endpoints are rejected by the API.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: The shared drive from which changes will be returned. If specified, change IDs will be specific to the shared drive.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: The maximum number of changes to return per page.

inputs.name: expiration
inputs.about: Timestamp in milliseconds since the epoch for when the channel should expire. If not set, channel may not expire or have a default expiration. Channels are invalidated after expiry; re-establish the watch with a new channel before or after expiration to avoid missed changes.

inputs.name: page_token
inputs.about: The token for continuing a previous list request on the next page. This should be set to the value of 'nextPageToken' from the previous response or to the response from the getStartPageToken method. Persist this token per channel so change processing can resume correctly after restarts or interrupti

inputs.name: include_labels
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the labelInfo part of the response.

inputs.name: include_removed
inputs.about: Whether to include changes indicating that items have been removed from the list of changes (e.g., by deletion or loss of access).

inputs.name: supports_all_drives
inputs.about: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Recommended to set to true if driveId is used or if interactions with shared drives are expected.

inputs.name: restrict_to_my_drive
inputs.about: Whether to restrict the results to changes inside the My Drive hierarchy. This omits changes to files like those in the Application Data folder or shared files not added to My Drive.

inputs.name: include_corpus_removals
inputs.about: Whether changes should include the file resource if the file is still accessible by the user at the time of the request, even when a file was removed from the list of changes.

inputs.name: include_permissions_for_view
inputs.about: Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response.

inputs.name: include_items_from_all_drives
inputs.about: Whether both My Drive and shared drive items should be included in results.

tools.name: Watch File for Changes
tools.description: Tool to subscribe to push notifications for changes to a specific file. Use when you need to monitor a file for modifications and receive real-time notifications at a webhook URL.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: A UUID or similar unique string that identifies this notification channel (max 64 characters).

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The type of delivery mechanism used for this channel.

inputs.name: token
inputs.about: An arbitrary string delivered to the target address with each notification for verification (max 256 characters).

inputs.name: fileId
inputs.about: The ID of the file to watch for changes.

inputs.name: params
inputs.about: Additional parameters controlling delivery channel behavior.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: The HTTPS address where notifications are delivered for this channel. Must have a valid SSL certificate.

inputs.name: payload
inputs.about: Whether payload data should be included in notifications.

inputs.name: expiration
inputs.about: Date and time of notification channel expiration as Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Default: 3600 seconds, max: 86400 seconds for files.

inputs.name: includeLabels
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the labelInfo part of the response.

inputs.name: acknowledgeAbuse
inputs.about: Whether the user is acknowledging the risk of downloading known malware or other abusive files. Only applicable to file owner/organizer.

inputs.name: supportsAllDrives
inputs.about: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives.

inputs.name: supportsTeamDrives
inputs.about: Deprecated. Use supportsAllDrives instead.

inputs.name: includePermissionsForView
inputs.about: Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response.

tools.name: Write Spreadsheet Values
tools.description: Replace values in one range of a Google spreadsheet.

inputs.name: range
inputs.about: The A1 notation range whose values to replace, such as 'Sheet1!A1:B2'.

inputs.name: values
inputs.about: A matrix of string, number, boolean, or null cell values. Each inner list follows major_dimension.

inputs.name: spreadsheet_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Google spreadsheet to update.

inputs.name: major_dimension
inputs.about: How the values matrix is oriented. Defaults to ROWS when omitted.

inputs.name: value_input_option
inputs.about: Required interpretation mode. RAW stores values as supplied; USER_ENTERED parses them as if entered in Google Sheets.

inputs.name: include_values_in_response
inputs.about: Whether the response should include the values written in updatedData.

inputs.name: response_value_render_option
inputs.about: How values in updatedData are rendered when updated values are included.

inputs.name: response_date_time_render_option
inputs.about: How dates, times, and durations in updatedData are rendered when updated values are included.
